understanding.restatement: You're choosing between a MacBook Air and a MacBook Pro for everyday work and some photo editing.

preliminaryRecommendation.rationale: Portability is doing most of the work here.

reasons.title: It's the one you'll actually carry
reasons.detail: You move with it daily and the Air is meaningfully lighter.

reasons.title: Fast enough for your editing
reasons.detail: Your photo work sits well inside what the Air handles.

reasons.title: Leaves budget on the table
reasons.detail: You keep several hundred euros for storage or a display.

tradeoffs.givingUp: Sustained performance under heavy export loads

risks.title: Heavier editing later
risks.detail: If your work shifts to video, the Air will feel tight.

assumptions.statement: Photo editing means Lightroom-scale work, not 4K video.
assumptions.impactIfWrong: The Pro becomes the better choice.

research.claim: The MacBook Air weighs about 1.24 kg versus 1.55 kg for the 14-inch Pro.

whatCouldMakeMeWrong: If you start exporting long 4K video, the Pro wins.
